map.同样现金流不折现时累计为 −5000、−2500、0、+2500，恰好 2 年回: With the same cash flows undiscounted, cumulative values are −5000, −2500, 0, +2500, so it pays back in exactly 2 years; after discounting about 2.35 years. The extra 0.35 years is the cost of tying up capital over that period, and the gap widens as the discount rate rises.
map.折现回收期：r′ = r÷100，逐年累计 cum += 第 i 期现金流 ÷: Discounted payback period: r′ = r÷100, accumulating year by year cum += period-i cash flow ÷ (1+r′)^i (cf₀ at time zero is not discounted); at the first period i where the cumulative turns positive, payback = (i−1) + (−previous cumulative) ÷ current discounted cash flow, and if it is already positive at period 0 it is recorded as 0 years. Validation: all five fields (CF₀, CF₁–CF₃ and the discount rate) are required; a blank field is no longer treated as 0 (a blank CF₀ would falsely report a 0-year payback, and a blank year would mean that year has no cash flow), and non-numeric input raises an error; the discount rate must be greater than −100% (at exactly −100% the discount factor is 0 from period 1 on, so per-period discounting is undefined). Criteria: when the four-period cumulative discounted cash flow stays negative it outputs “not recovered” together with the final cumulative value, and a successful payback is shown as x.xx years; the result area also lists each period's discount factor, discounted cash flow and cumulative value for line-by-line checking. When CF₀ ≥ 0 the cumulative is never negative to begin with, so payback is always 0 years, and the page adds a hint that the sign may be reversed.
